CYBELANGEL_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Optional severity floor applied client-side on the threats surface. Accepts the canonical Faraday enum (info / low / medium / high / critical) plus CybelAngel-side aliases (Important / Major / Moderate / Informational / Negligible / Sev1..Sev5 / P1..P5). Defaults to '' (no filter; we emit the full hits surface). Garbage values are logged and ignored.

CYBELANGEL_FROM_DATE.description: Optional date floor forwarded to /api/2.0/threats as the created_after query parameter (the /api/2.0/assets surface ignores this filter). Accepts ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) or RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z or 2024-01-01T00:00:00+00:00). Defaults to '' (no filter; CybelAngel returns the full threats surface the token has access to). Garbage values are logged and ignored.

CYBELANGEL_PAGES.description: Optional per-surface page-walk cap. Each CybelAngel v2.0 search page returns up to 100 hits via limit=100; CYBELANGEL_PAGES bounds the offset walk so a stray operator filter can't fan out into 100k+ requests against the rate-limited CybelAngel API. Numeric / numeric-string input accepted; floats are floored. Clamped to [1, 50]. Defaults to 5 (≈ 500 hits per surface, 1000 total across assets + threats).

name: cybelangel
title: CybelAngel
description: CybelAngel EASM / digital-risk importer. Pulls externally-discovered assets and threats (credentials, leaked code, exposed PII, brand abuse, fraud sites, etc.) from the CybelAngel platform and emits Faraday bulk-create JSON. Each CybelAngel asset becomes one Faraday host (ip = the asset's first public IP, falling back to synthetic 0.0.0.0 for domain-keyed assets); per-asset threats attach as one Faraday vulnerability per threat_id with the [EASM] engine prefix. Endpoints used: GET /api/2.0/assets (paginated external-asset inventory; the canonical CybelAngel pivot — every threat joins by asset_id) and GET /api/2.0/threats (paginated digital-risk threats inventory with severity + category + cves + remediation guidance, with optional created_after date floor). Pagination is offset-based: limit=100 per page, offset advanced via the response envelope's next_offset cursor (or current_offset + page_size when the envelope is silent), walked page-by-page until the page comes up short or CYBELANGEL_PAGES is reached. Severity bucketing walks the string severity field first (Critical / High / Medium / Low / Info) and falls back to priority / risk_rating / risk_score (CybelAngel 0-100 scale) then CVSS when nothing else lands; aliases collapse CybelAngel-side labels (Important / Major / Moderate / Informational / Negligible / Sev1..Sev5 / P1..P5) onto the canonical Faraday bucket. Status mapping covers new / in_progress / investigating / pending -> open, resolved / closed / remediated / takedown -> closed, and false_positive / risk_accepted / wont_fix -> risk-accepted. Refs include CybelAngel-Asset / CybelAngel-AssetName / CybelAngel-AssetType / CybelAngel-Id / CybelAngel-Category / CybelAngel-Source pivots plus any url / reference_url / evidence_url / source_url surfaced on the threat. Auth: CybelAngel uses OAuth2 client_credentials — the operator creates an API client in the CybelAngel console under Settings -> API Keys -> New Client and the dispatcher exchanges CYBELANGEL_CLIENT_ID + CYBELANGEL_CLIENT_SECRET for a short-lived JWT at https://auth.cybelangel.com/oauth/token (CYBELANGEL_AUTH_HOST settable for on-prem), then carries the token on every /api/2.0/ request as Authorization: Bearer <access_token>. The API host defaults to https://platform.cybelangel.com (CYBELANGEL_HOST settable) and the audience defaults to https://platform.cybelangel.com/ (CYBELANGEL_AUDIENCE settable). Tags: [cybelangel, easm].
